name: adb
description: Android Debug Bridge for device management and wireless debugging

adb.description: Android Debug Bridge for device management and wireless debugging
adb.usage:
adb devices -l # List connected devices with detailed transport info
adb connect 192.168.1.100:5555 # Connect to device over Wi-Fi
adb install --fastdeploy -r app.apk # Fast incremental APK installation
adb shell pm list packages -3 # List third-party installed packages
adb shell dumpsys battery # Get detailed battery information
adb pull /sdcard/DCIM/ ./photos/ --sync # Sync entire camera folder
adb push build/ /data/local/tmp/ --sync # Upload build directory
adb logcat -c && adb logcat MyApp:V *:S # Clear logs and filter by app
adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_POWER # Simulate power button press
adb forward tcp:8080 tcp:8080 # Port forwarding for local development
